title: zeuxine diversifolia
intro: Zeuxine diversifolia, commonly known as the yellow orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Zeuxine diversifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
